title: When the Extraction Burns
author: Ulyana Winterbourne
blurb: Felix Lockridge, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
